```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(svglite)
library(patchwork)
```


```{r}
df <- read.csv("T:/Labs/Spakowicz/ppiio/data/derived/2025-02-17/CoRR_formatted.csv") %>%
  select("days", "vitalstatus", "line_of_therapy", "prior_chemo", "chemo_greater_one_year", "h2b_iostart", "H2B.days.to.iostart")
```


```{r}
all_surv <- survfit(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ h2b_iostart, data = df)

all_surv_plot <- ggsurvplot(all_surv, 
                            pval = T, 
                            risk.table = T,
                            tables.height = 0.29,
                            title = "OS for All Cancers",
                            legend.title = "",
                            ylab = "",
                            legend.labs = c("Not Prescribed", "Prescribed H2Bs"),
                            palette = c("slateblue2","lightsalmon2"),
                            fontsize = 4,
                            font.legend = list(size= 9))
all_surv_plot
combined_all_surv <- all_surv_plot$plot / all_surv_plot$table + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))
combined_all_surv
```

```{r}
first_line <- survfit(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ h2b_iostart, data = df[df$line_of_therapy == 1,])

first_line_plot <- ggsurvplot(first_line, pval = T, risk.table = T, tables.height = 0.29,
                              title = "OS for First Line ICI",
                            legend.title = "",
                            ylab = "",
                            legend.labs = c("Not Prescribed", "Prescribed H2B's"),
                            palette = c("slateblue2","lightsalmon2"),
                            fontsize = 4,
                            font.legend = list(size= 9))

first_line_plot
combined_first_line <- first_line_plot$plot / first_line_plot$table + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))
combined_first_line
```
```{r}
second_line <- survfit(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ h2b_iostart, data = df[df$line_of_therapy != 1,])

second_line_plot <- ggsurvplot(second_line, pval = T, risk.table = T, tables.height = 0.29,
                               title = "OS for Second Line ICI and Beyond",
                            legend.title = "",
                            ylab = "",
                            legend.labs = c("Not Prescribed", "Prescribed H2B"),
                            palette = c("slateblue2","lightsalmon2"),
                            fontsize = 4,
                            font.legend = list(size= 9))

second_line_plot
combined_second_line <- second_line_plot$plot / second_line_plot$table + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))
combined_second_line
```
```{r}
no_chemo <- survfit(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ h2b_iostart, data = df[df$prior_chemo == "no",])

no_chemo_plot <- ggsurvplot(no_chemo, pval = T, risk.table = T,
                             tables.height = 0.29,
                            title = "OS for No Prior Chemotherapy",
                            legend.title = "",
                            ylab = "",
                            legend.labs = c("Not Prescribed", "Prescribed H2B's"),
                            palette = c("slateblue2","lightsalmon2"),
                            fontsize = 4,
                            font.legend = list(size= 9)) 
no_chemo_plot
combined_no_chemo <- no_chemo_plot$plot / no_chemo_plot$table + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))
combined_no_chemo
```
```{r}
chemo <- survfit(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ h2b_iostart, data = df[df$prior_chemo == "yes",])

chemo_plot <- ggsurvplot(chemo, pval = T, risk.table = T, tables.height = 0.29,
                         title = "OS for Prior Chemotherapy",
                            legend.title = "",
                            ylab = "",
                            legend.labs = c("Not Prescribed", "Prescribed H2B's"),
                            palette = c("slateblue2","lightsalmon2"),
                            fontsize = 4,
                            font.legend = list(size= 12)) 
chemo_plot
combined_chemo <- chemo_plot$plot / chemo_plot$table + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))
combined_chemo
```


```{r}
more_than_one_year <- survfit(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ h2b_iostart, data = df[df$chemo_greater_one_year == 1,])

more_than_one_year_plot <- ggsurvplot(more_than_one_year, pval = T, risk.table = T,  tables.height = 0.29,
                                      title = "OS for Chemotherapy Greater than One Year",
                           legend.title = "",
                            ylab = "",
                            legend.labs = c("Not Prescribed", "Prescribed H2B's"),
                            palette = c("slateblue2","lightsalmon2"),
                            fontsize = 4,
                            font.legend = list(size= 9)) 
more_than_one_year_plot
combined_more_than_one_year <- more_than_one_year_plot$plot / more_than_one_year_plot$table + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))
combined_more_than_one_year
```
```{r}
less_than_one_year <- survfit(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ h2b_iostart, data = df[df$chemo_greater_one_year == 0,])

less_than_one_year_plot <- ggsurvplot(less_than_one_year, pval = T, risk.table = T, tables.height = 0.29,
                                      title = "OS for Chemotherapy One Year or Less",
                            legend.title = "",

                            legend.labs = c("Not Prescribed", "Prescribed H2B's"),

less_than_one_year_plot
combined_less_than_one_year <- less_than_one_year_plot$plot / less_than_one_year_plot$table + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))
combined_less_than_one_year
```
